ap_halo.explanation: Multi-ring AP pattern (4 radial peaks, mimic score 0.89). May be button battery OR stacked coins. Obtain lateral view and treat as battery until ruled out.

explanation: Multi-ring AP pattern (4 radial peaks, mimic score 0.89). May be button battery OR stacked coins. Obtain lateral view and treat as battery until ruled out. Stacked-coin mimic pattern (AP peaks=4, mimic=0.89) — conservative battery protocol.

protocol.time_window: Target endoscopy within 2 hours of ingestion
actions: NPO immediately — no food or drink
Two-view series if only AP obtained
If ambiguous halo: treat as battery until endoscopy rules out
protocol.reese_law_note: Reese's Law (P.L. 117-171) mandated safer battery packaging after pediatric deaths. Haloscan addresses the remaining diagnostic gap — packaging cannot help after ingestion.
